constraints: all non-water cells reachable from command center
no other site adjacent to boss_hatch
findsNote: blue channel counts all finds; the sensor's blue window also shows the icon of the most valuable find among neighbours (findValue). Finds never affect the danger logic.

zones.method: seeded Voronoi on non-water cells outside the safe radius, then 1 smoothing pass (a cell switches to the majority of its 8 neighbours if ≥5)

cellElements.lairsLeanToZone: hero lair: hero's mutation element = zone element with 60% chance; adaptants of nests in the zone always take the zone element
squadRule: at least 1 zone touching the safe radius is WEAK (config dig.cellDurability.cellWeakTo) to an element present in the squad
at least 1 zone touching the safe radius RESISTS the squad's most common element
the boss_hatch zone resists the squad's most common element (no straight line to the boss)
cellElements.dangerUnaffected: cell elements never change mines/sensor logic and never hint where nests are, only what element a nest inside would have
